observations: Photo 0: black Canon DSLR with "Canon" on the prism and "EOS 650D" on the front right; lens attached with front cap.
Photo 1: rear view with LCD screen closed inward; control buttons and hand grip visible.
Photo 2: top view with mode dial, hot shoe, and lens barrel marked 18, 24, 35, 55.
All photos carry watermark "MCSTEVE POSTED ON JIJI".

claims.evidence: photo 0 body reads Canon EOS 650D; D650 is a typo for 650D
photo 2 lens barrel shows 18 to 55 focal lengths
still photos cannot confirm camera operation
country of use cannot be verified from photos

risks.risk: Camera does not power on or function
risks.proof: video of camera turning on, navigating menus, and releasing shutter

risks.risk: Lens has fungus, haze, or separation
risks.proof: close-up photos of front and rear lens elements against light
screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or software

risks.risk: Battery, charger, or accessories missing or dead
risks.proof: photo of battery and charger, video of camera running on battery

risks.risk: Hidden body damage from drops or water
risks.proof: close-up photos of body seams, LCD, and mirror box

proof_requests: Video showing camera powering on, navigating menus, and taking a photo
Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements
Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu
Photo of battery, charger, and included accessories
response.reason: The photos clearly identify a Canon EOS 650D with an 18-55mm lens; the seller's 750D claim is contradicted by the body marking, and unproven functionality means it is priced at worst case as non-working.
